subject: Post-demo: Security follow-up and IR/BCP evidence request
messages:
From: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@newhorizonhealth.com>, Elena Gómez <elena.gomez@newhorizonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-23T22:02:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: Security follow-up and IR/BCP evidence request

Hi Suresh and Elena —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. A couple of follow-up items on the security/compliance side so your security and procurement teams can start their review in parallel with product evaluation. I’ve attached a short vendor security questionnaire and a one-page SOC 2 summary for reference.

Ask list (action items and suggested owners):
- NewHorizon: please complete the attached vendor security questionnaire and send back by EOD Tue, Jun 30 (procurement lead or security engineer).
- NewHorizon: confirm whether HIPAA-specific BAAs are required or if the initial scope is SOC 2 + GDPR-only.
- Redwood: provide IR & breach notification windows and example BCP/DR artifacts (runbook snippets, recovery RTO/RPO targets). See attached checklist.
- Both: schedule a 30-min call next week with your security engineer and our reliability lead (I’ve proposed slots in the Drive folder link below).

Quick clarifications from the demo that I promised:
- Data residency: Hosted API region options include us-west and eu-west; private deployments available for on-prem/VPC.
- Logs/audit: token-level tracing available with 90-day retention by default; extended retention is an add-on.

Attachments: newhorizon-vendor-security-questionnaire.docx (please use track changes if you edit), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, ir-bcp-evidence-checklist.xlsx

Shared folder for artifacts and meeting times: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cExampleSharedFolder

If you prefer, I can loop in our Legal/Contracts lead for any BAA conversations — just let me know.

Thanks,
Kim Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@newhorizonhealth.com>
To: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Gómez <elena.gomez@newhorizonhealth.com>, procurement@newhorizonhealth.com
Date: 2026-06-24T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security follow-up and IR/BCP evidence request

Kim — thanks for the recap and the materials. Quick responses:

- We'll aim to return the questionnaire by Tue, Jun 30; Elena will lead that.
- We will likely need a BAA; our security lead flagged PHI concerns for one initial integration path. Can your Legal team share a standard BAA template or a pointer to where we can review language?
- For IR/breach notice: Could you give a short summary of your notification windows (e.g., detection -> internal alert -> customer notification) and a sample timeline? Procurement also wants to know what evidence we should expect (logs, runbooks, post-incident reports).

Also looping in procurement for contracting cadence.

Thanks,
Suresh
Director of IT Security | NewHorizon Health
suresh.patel@newhorizonhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@newhorizonhealth.com>, Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Gómez <elena.gomez@newhorizonhealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-24T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security follow-up and IR/BCP evidence request

Suresh — great questions. Short answers up front, full artifacts attached/linked below.

- BAA: we do support BAAs for customers handling PHI. I’ll loop in Legal if you want a formal exchange; I can attach our standard BAA template.
- Notification windows (typical):
   1) Detection/triage: within minutes via monitoring alerts;
   2) Initial internal incident classification & containment steps: within 1 hour;
   3) Customer notification: within 24 hours for confirmed incidents affecting customer data (we follow customer-specific notification windows if included in contract).
- Evidence we can provide on request: SOC 2 report (summary attached), audit logs (token-level), incident post-mortem (redacted), DR runbook excerpts, and timeline artifacts. If you need forensic-level artifacts we coordinate a forensic pack on a case-by-case basis.

Attached in shared Drive: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, ir-bcp-evidence-checklist.xlsx, sample-baa-template.pdf (I'll add Legal to the drive if needed).

If helpful, we can propose a short working session with our Reliability Engineer to walk the DR runbook and answer technical questions. Proposed window Thurs 6/25 10–11am PT or Fri 6/26 8–9am PT.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Elena Gómez <elena.gomez@newhorizonhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@newhorizonhealth.com>, procurement@newhorizonhealth.com, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T16:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security follow-up and IR/BCP evidence request

Thanks Kim and Ben —

We reviewed the questionnaire quickly and have a few clarifying asks before we complete it:
- For audit logs, can you confirm whether token-level logs include request payloads or only metadata (IP, time, model used)? We need to confirm what constitutes PHI in logs.
- For breach notification, would Redwood accept a 24-hour SLA to notify us of confirmed breaches plus a 72-hour follow-up with impact assessment? Procurement wants this explicitly in contract language.
- Please add your Legal contact for the BAA template in the Drive link so our counsel can start a parallel review.

We can meet Fri 6/26 08:30 PT for a short DR/IR review — procurement copied for scheduling.

Elena
Security Engineer | NewHorizon Health
elena.gomez@newhorizonhealth.com
